items.title: SGE confident of UK SMR fleet prospects
items.summary: The team behind plans for a fleet of 14 BWRX-300 small modular reactors in the UK says they are confident of the economic model and supply chain capability to deliver these units.

items.title: Škoda JS to supply control rod drives for Rolls-Royce SMR's reactors
items.summary: Czech company Škoda JS has been chosen as sole supplier of control rod drive mechanisms for Rolls-Royce SMR's future small modular reactors.
